title: Stop Reinventing SPFx- Building Better SharePoint Solutions with PnP React Controls with Siddharth Vaghasia [MVP]
description:
Many SharePoint developers keep rebuilding the same pickers, data calls and controls. In this interview, MVP Siddharth Vaghasia shows developers and architects how SPFx, PnPjs and the PnP React controls speed up secure, performant SharePoint solutions and where SPFx fits next to Power Apps and Copilot agents.
In this episode
00:00 – Intro and guest background04:17 – What SharePoint Framework is11:13 – SPFx or Power Platform?15:18 – Inside an SPFx project: TypeScript, Fluent UI, PnPjs, PnP controls33:31 – Microsoft Graph and permissions39:45 – Security mistakes47:09 – Performance, batching and accessibility54:20 – Deployment, agents and rapid fire
Key takeaways
Before customizing SharePoint, check whether Microsoft or the PnP React controls already provide what you need, and only build custom components when they do not.SPFx solutions run with the delegated permissions of the signed-in user, so request minimal permissions and never put secrets in client-side code; use a backend API instead.With AI-assisted coding, SPFx has become a fast option for rich user interfaces, while Power Apps remains the better fit for simple forms without code maintenance.
Worth quoting
“So I would say if you need a very, very good user interface, you can basically go with SPFX and you can create a full-fledged application there” – Siddharth Vaghasia (13:35)
“Good thing about power apps is that you are not maintaining the code. You do not need a skill set with react or SPFX.” – Siddharth Vaghasia (14:55)
